required_policy: Every listed field is required in an instantiated row. Nullable fields remain null with an explanation in missingness_reasons. Null is not false or zero. Arrays may be empty only when conceptually valid. This is a proposed field contract, not a runtime validator.

identity.protocol_id: string; frozen protocol and amendment ID
identity.program_id: string; product/regimen x indication/population x origin phase
identity.source_record_ids: nonempty array; NCT and arm/substudy IDs
identity.origin_manifest_sha256: SHA256 of cohort freeze before endpoint joins

hypothesis.target_ids: array; empty with explanation if unresolved
hypothesis.intended_action: nullable string; never inferred from outcomes
hypothesis.target_aggregation_rule: nullable string; mandatory before target-level aggregation

scope.regimen: array; product, dose/schedule and experimental/background/comparator/rescue role
scope.population: object; disease/subtype, biomarker, stage/severity, prior therapy/line, age, geography
scope.next_phase: nullable string; numerical phase when applicable
scope.comparability: array; dimension, matched/mismatch/unknown/not_applicable, proof and rationale
scope.prior_qualifying_event: nullable boolean; late-disclosed pre-origin events retained

window.analytic_timezone: string; not an assertion about source timezone
window.source_time_precision: string; retain unknown or partial date precision

event.event_id: nullable string; shared event for deduplication/dependence

efficacy.comparison: nullable comparator or prespecified single-arm threshold
efficacy.uncertainty: nullable CI/SE with unit and level

observation.reporting_lag_qualified: boolean; actual evidence coverage through allowance cutoff

provenance.source_evidence: nonempty for decisions; official URL, content/row SHA256, version, locator, excerpt, availability and retrieval dates
provenance.adjudications: array; reviewer/agent/model identity, prompt hashes, blinded status, exposure, sources and rationale
provenance.disagreements: array; retain differing interpretations and resolution
provenance.independence_basis: string; multiple agent names do not certify independence
provenance.reference_row_sha256: nullable before sealing; required when sealed
provenance.reviewed_at: adjudication clock distinct from historical information

conditional_rules: Endpoint IDs never pool or silently substitute for original H1 clinical success.
Positive requires qualified origin risk and program scope, source proof and actual occurrence interval wholly within (origin, endpoint].
Actual study enrollment is not experimental-arm dosing; estimated or boundary-straddling dates cannot produce a positive label.
Efficacy negative requires an eligible final primary analysis explicitly failing its prespecified decision rule; study status or no posted results is insufficient.
Registry no-record negative requires a frozen qualified search through mature ascertainment cutoff and is not efficacy failure.
Censoring requires a source-supported pre-endpoint observation cutoff; missing evidence is not automatically censoring.
Binary value is null for unresolved, censored, ineligible and competing_event; positive=1 and negative=0 only for the named endpoint.
Efficacy labels require objective, analysis-population, decision-rule and multiplicity qualification; no efficacy objective means ineligible.
Occurrence, result data cutoff, initial registration, version post, public disclosure, snapshot and retrieval dates remain distinct.
Proposed 90 calendar days after 2026-01-01 ends 2026-04-01; events after endpoint remain excluded even when disclosed within allowance.
Outcome evidence remains evaluator-only and cannot enter historical predictor lineage.
Business stops and toxicity are separate events handled by frozen competing-event/composite policies, never automatic efficacy negatives.
AI adjudication can qualify operational procedures; it cannot automatically certify independent H5 expert preference or external validity.
No training admission without historical input eligibility, label availability before training cutoff, split/dependence and leakage gates.
Current mapping may assist evaluator discovery but cannot silently replace missing historical normalization.
Every sealed reference retains protocol hash, source proofs, exposure record and admitted uses.
